input.summary: Narrow § 22.14 non-solicit to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months after involvement ends, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed the mutual non-solicit in § 22.14 to employees directly involved in performing the Services and limited it to twelve months after that involvement ends, and added the customary carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. This reflects our fallback position; the clause as drafted covers all employees for the entire Term with no carve-outs.

ops.oldText: 22.14 Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
ops.newText: 22.14 Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party who are directly involved in performing the Services, during their involvement and for twelve (12) months thereafter. This restriction does not apply to general advertisements or unsolicited approaches.
